components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one blue action. Deepened fill in light, dark ink on raw blue in dark.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.55 0.15 245); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.5 0.13 245); border-radius: 1.3rem; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.5 0.13 245); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.15 245); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent, bordered, soft-blue hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.5 0.02 248); border: 1px solid oklch(0.9317 0.0118 231.6594); border-radius: 1.3rem; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: oklch(0.1884 0.0128 248.5103); background: oklch(0.9392 0.0166 250.8453); border-color: oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.3540); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.15 245); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Pill field with white well and blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: oklch(0.1884 0.0128 248.5103); border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.008 240); border-radius: 1.3rem; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(15,20,25,0.45); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.3540); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,119,194,0.25); } .ds-input:disabled { background: oklch(0.9222 0.0013 286.3737); color: oklch(0.55 0.015 248); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Raised content surface: pill radius, 1px border, resting blue-tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: oklch(0.9784 0.0011 197.1387); color: oklch(0.1884 0.0128 248.5103); border: 1px solid oklch(0.9317 0.0118 231.6594); border-radius: 1.3rem; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(29,161,242,0.15); font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-panel-title { font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-panel-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; color: oklch(0.5 0.02 248); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Sidebar row: muted at rest, soft-blue hover, raised active pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: block; color: oklch(0.5 0.02 248); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 1.3rem; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { color: oklch(0.1884 0.0128 248.5103); background: oklch(0.9392 0.0166 250.8453); } .ds-nav-active { color: oklch(0.5 0.13 245); background: oklch(0.9392 0.0166 250.8453); border-color: oklch(0.9317 0.0118 231.6594); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.15 245); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Count chip: soft blue fill with accent-strong text, never a solid wash.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: oklch(0.9392 0.0166 250.8453); color: oklch(0.5 0.13 245); border: 1px solid oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.3540); border-radius: 1.3rem; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Remotely is an operations console first and a brand surface second: an IT technician opens it to reach a machine and act on it, not to browse. The visual world therefore borrows the energy of a social platform — one vivid blue voice on a black-or-white stage, pill-shaped controls, generous rounding — while keeping the density and plainness of a working tool. The liveliness is in the accent, not in the chrome: surfaces stay quiet so the single blue can carry action, selection, and status. The system is built on one accent family (Twitter blue in OKLCH) plus semantic status hues that are signals, never decoration. Dark and light themes are two composed palettes sharing the same token names — every component rule is written once against `--rm-*` tokens declared in `Server/wwwroot/css/Themes/*.custom.css`, so a theme switch never leaves a surface behind. Depth is tonal, not shadowed: flat surfaces separated by lightness and 1px borders, with blue-tinted shadows reserved for hover elevation.
keyCharacteristics: One chromatic voice: Platform Blue carries every action, link, and live state.
Pill controls: `1.3rem` radius on buttons, inputs, panels, and cards.
Flat by default: tonal layers and borders, shadows only on hover.
Open Sans everywhere; Menlo for code and data.
Status colors are signals (green = online, yellow = outdated, red = destructive), never decoration.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Platform Blue is the only decorative hue. Green, amber, and red appear only as status signals with text or shape reinforcement; a green link would read as "online" and is never used.

rules.name: The One Sans Rule
rules.body: Open Sans is the only text face. Menlo appears only for code, logs, and tabular data — never as a "technical" costume for UI copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth appears as a response to state (hover, modal, focus). A resting panel with a soft shadow is drift; a resting panel with a border is the system.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: If it is a control or a container in the console, it is `1.3rem`. Small radii survive only in the viewer's legacy chrome.

dos: Do paint every console color from a `--rm-*` token declared in `Server/wwwroot/css/Themes/*.custom.css` — a raw hex in a component rule will not survive a theme switch.
Do keep both themes declaring the same token names; a missing token silently keeps old behavior in one theme.
Do derive text colors at AA: body ≥ 4.5:1, controls and focus ≥ 3:1 — verify computed pairs, not eyeballs.
Do let Platform Blue own action, selection, focus, and the connect affordance — and nothing decorative.
Do pair every status color with text, a dot, or a glyph.
Do use pill radius (`1.3rem`) for console controls and containers; keep tabular numerals for data.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue (no cyan, no slate blue, no generic Bootstrap palette escapes) — Bootstrap classes must route through the `--bs-*` bridges in the custom theme files.
Don't put white text on raw Platform Blue (`#1DA1F2` is 2.94:1) — deepen it in light, use dark ink in dark.
Don't use green for links or interactive text — green means online.
Don't add resting drop shadows for depth — use tonal steps and borders; shadows are hover/modal only.
Don't show a placeholder and a floating label at the same time — the placeholder stays transparent until focus.
Don't regenerate the enforced brand assets (logos, banners, icons) — they are authoritative inputs, not design output.
